content: Hyperparameter settings: The hidden-layer size of each LSTM within the model is set 512. We use a dropout with the probability of 0.2 on the output of the LSTM encoders. The embedding dimension from ELMo is 1024. The optimization method we use is Adam BIBREF23 . We train with a batch size of 32 for 30 epochs. The model was implemented using the TensorFlow framework.
